what: Compatible odd Harnack-split collections through size 4. q1 finished size at most 3 (368,936 evaluations, twelve known M-schemes). The published a=10 nest has seven odd splits, so size 4 is the next enumerable odd skeleton.
note: Residue. Size 3 replayed the q1 count. Size 4 was still running at 40 of 189 when this snapshot was written and had not left those twelve schemes. Not a lower bound.
